newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile to offer 500,000 lbs cobalt in August.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile to offer 500,000 lbs cobalt in August.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it planned to offer for sale 500,000 lbs of cobalt in August, with the intention of selling a further 1.5 million lbs in September.
Cobalt sales were suspended in March following a legal battle between Stockpile and trader Minor Metals Inc.
A judge removed a restraining order on Stockpile sales on June 18.
Stockpile said Tuesday that on July 7 it will issue an invitation for bids -- DLA COBALT 006 -- offering 500,000 lbs of cobalt in a one-time sealed bid format.
The bids will be opened at 1300 EDT Aug 6.
In addition, a draft soliciation offering 1,500,000 lbs by negotiated procedures will be issued in mid to late July.
"This is in anticipation of an industry meeting to be held in the Washington DC metropolitan area in late July or early August.
The final soliciation -- DLA COBALT 007 -- will be issued in August for award in September.
The soliciations will include data from 1997 chemical analyses of all lots conducted by a Minor Metals Trade Association certified sampler/analyst.
"However, the metal will continue to be offered without warranty or guarantee that the material will be suitable for any particular purpose," Stockpile said in a statement.
